utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Cleo — I’ll be around late, and I can still help with the repair drive. Just point me to the setup when I get there, and I’ll catch up fast.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll head to the community shed Saturday from 10 to 2 and bring what I can. Thanks, Cleo; I’ll catch up and jump in when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll aim for late Saturday morning and keep it clear of the school run. If you settle on a specific time, I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a few tools and help keep the repair drive moving—just point me to the stops and I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That would be a huge help, Gus — could you bring the tools to the first stop and help sort the donated items by type as we go?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring the tools to the first stop and help sort everything by type as we go.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Jules — quick update: the repair drive moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center. If you can help with a time or a list of needed fixes, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll help keep folks coordinated and in the loop for the repair drive. I’ll check on a time and the needed fixes, then pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Jules — that’s a big help. Once you have the time and fix list, send it my way and I’ll get everything updated.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — that still works for me. I can handle the sign-up sheet and check-in, and I’ll keep an eye out for your fixes list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — I’ll send the fixes list shortly.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll get the sign-up sheet and check-in ready, and I’ll watch for your fixes list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ve got it by the front gate. Just let me know if you need anything else from me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Bo — I’ll swing by and see what you need. If I can bring anything, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just let me know when you’re on your way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Just to confirm, what time should we set for the repair drive at my place by the front gate?

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.text: Dane: Perfect — once you’re here, we can go over the list together and make sure everything’s set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Ira, I’m helping spread the word for the repair drive — want me to put your name down or drop by with the details?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn — I haven’t heard the latest yet, but I’d appreciate you dropping by with the details if you get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll drop by with the details soon. If you’ve got any spare tools or screws, feel free to bring them too, but no worries if not.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, confirm the list first, and then tell me what’s still missing from the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Pia

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community shed, and we’re collecting tools, tape, batteries, and any small spare parts. If you want, I can send the full supply list too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, thanks — please send the full supply list too, and if you have the drop-off order I can sort the timing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help out; just remind me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll send the fixes list shortly — mostly the small repairs we already noted. Saturday at the community center still works.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, perfect—Saturday at the community center works for me. Just send the list when you can, and I’ll bring what I can manage.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Rosa — I can help sort the route and drop-off details, and I’ll bring any tools we need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Gus — that’s a big help. The repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, so let’s line up the route and drop-off details there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Rosa — I’ll line up the route and drop-off details for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, I can do that. I’ll sort the donated items by type and pull out anything broken first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll keep everyone coordinated on the repair drive and circle back with the time once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — that works for me. I’ll sort the donated items first and be ready once you set the time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks Mara — I’ll confirm the time and let you know as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you confirm the repair drive time and place one more time, just so I have it right? If Saturday at the community center still works, I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — Saturday at the community center still works for me. Thanks, Hana, I appreciate the help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it straightforward: list the repairs, then pick a time that works for everyone. If we start with the broken items, we can move through the rest in order.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds good—what repairs are already on the list, and what time are we aiming for?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d start with the broken chairs, the lamp, and the box of small tools. For timing, how about Saturday morning so we can work through them without rushing?
